name: Dealing With Evil People
overview: Scripture teaches that when facing evil people, believers are called to trust fully in the LORD's protection and strength rather than seeking personal vengeance, as seen in Exodus 14:14 and Psalms 27:1. Wisdom is shown in restraint and self-control, avoiding foolish outbursts (Proverbs 29:11), while the Lord declares that true peace is absent from the wicked (Isaiah 48:22). Jesus challenges the old law of retaliation and the notion of hating enemies, instead urging love and grace beyond human instinct (Matthew 5:38, 43).
